pr.title: Create data-api .NET 6 Web API with PostgreSQL employees endpoint

story.user_story: As a developer, I want to create a .NET Core Web API named data-api that connects to a PostgreSQL database (mysample) and retrieves data from the employees table, so that other applications can consume employee information via REST endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: A new .NET Core Web API project named data-api is created.
The API should connect to a PostgreSQL database named mysample.
A table named employees exists in the database.
Entity Framework Core is used for database interaction.
A DbContext is configured for PostgreSQL.
An Employee entity model is created based on the employees table.
A repository or service layer is implemented to fetch employee data.
A controller (EmployeesController) is created with the following endpoint: GET /api/employees → returns all employee records.
The API returns data in JSON format.
Basic error handling and logging are implemented.

notes: Implemented .NET 6 Web API under src/data-api with EF Core (DB-first style) MysampleContext + Employee model.
Added repository/service layers with paging + filtering contract and JSON envelope.
Added Serilog JSON console logging and global exception middleware.
Added MSTest unit tests for repository/service/controller and Dockerfile copying certs.
